title: 8 Limbs of Yoga
tagline: Ashtanga — the complete path of yoga
description: Master the comprehensive eightfold path of yoga, from ethical foundations and physical practice to deep internal states of awareness.

sutra.meaning:
“By the sustained practice of the eight limbs of yoga, the impurities are destroyed and the light of wisdom, discrimination shines forth.”

Yama (moral injunctions), Niyama (observances), Āsana (posture), Prāṇāyāma (regulation of breath), Pratyāhāra (withholding of senses), Dhāraṇā (fixity of attention), Dhyāna (meditation), and Samādhi (absorption of consciousness in the self) are the eight accessories (limbs) of Yoga
sutra.padaVibhaga: yoga | aṅga | anuṣṭhānāt | aśuddhi | kṣaye | jñāna-dīptiḥ | ā | viveka-khyāteḥ
sutra.wordMeanings: yoga = yoga; aṅga = limbs; anuṣṭhānāt = from practice; aśuddhi = impurity; kṣaye = on destruction; jñāna-dīptiḥ = light of knowledge; ā = up to; viveka-khyāteḥ = discernment

sections.gurudevInsight: A seed has the possibility that if it is not watered, then the possibility remains a possibility, it doesn’t manifest. Here patanjali steps in & says yogaangaanushthana - By practicing the limbs of yoga, by observing the limbs of Yoga, through yoga the impurities get eliminated & the viveka, the wisdom shines forth. The husk is gone, the sprout moves though it & comes up. They are (1) Yama (2) Niyama (3) Aasana (4) Pranayama (5) Pratyahara (6) Dhyana (7) Dharana (8) Samadhi. He goes into the details of each & what is the result that you can expect from each one of them. Yoga has 8 limbs, like a chair has got four legs, yoga has 8 limbs, or legs.

A contemporary of Buddha was Mahavira, the promoter of Jain Religion – Jainism – his emphasis was more on Ahimsa & it is said where ever he would walk, upto 20 kms around, people would all drop their violence & the story goes to the extent that even the thorns would not prick anybody, the thorns would become soft & they would all lie down. sections.insight: Prana is the all permeating, auto generated  energy which sustains and destroys life. It is also at the heart of the practice of yoga.  Pranayama consists of prana + ayama ie regulation. Prana is vital to maintaining life and the systems of the body. Pranayama helps to keep its free flow.

sections.shlokaFrom: अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे |प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणा: || 29|| अपरे नियताहारा: प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति |सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषा: || 30||
sections.wisdomFrom: Still others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming breath, while some offer the incoming breath into the outgoing breath. Some arduously practice prāṇāyām and restrain the incoming and outgoing breaths, purely absorbed in the regulation of the life-energy. Yet others curtail their food intake and offer the breath into the life-energy as sacrifice. All these knowers of sacrifice are cleansed of their impurities as a result of such performances.
sections.gurudevInsight: Pranayama: - tasmeensatishwaasprashwaasaya gati vichedaha pranayama In that state of Asana, unique state of asana, obstructing the flow of breath that is natural. Here he says, obstructing the natural flow because your flow is not natural at all. We have made our breath so unnatural by being unnatural, so what ever now is natural is not natural. We have to revert back, so how do we revert back? Not just accepting what is, however the breath is going on, I accept it - no.

sutra.meaning: Pranayam has three movements : regulated inhalation, exhalation and retention as per the sadhak's capacity.

sections.insight: Pranayam need to be practiced with awareness as per ones capacity over a long period of time.Practice everday gradually increasing the capacity of the lungs.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I practicing pranayam with attention and ease?
sections.practice: practice alternate nostril breathing at a very slow rate, for 9 rotations, focusing on inhalation for 4 , retention 2  and exhalation 6 counts.
sections.gurudevInsight: Ya – I see this alps, mountains, water – all this, whatever you see now – these are the proof. Three types of pramana – Pratyaksha – anumana, agama. Our Mind constantly wants to have an obvious, solid experiential proof. This is one mode of activity of the mind. It’s not so obvious, but you guess, & whatever you guess, you believe in it. The guessing of the mind, this is called anumana & then. [PDF p.9]

sutra.meaning: That which transcends the objective external and internal breath regulation is the fourth type of pranayama.

sections.insight: The fourth type of Pranayama goes beyond inhalation,exhalation amd retention. It happens of its own volition wherein a state of pause is experienced in both the breath and the mind. Therefore it is rightly called nirbeej pranayam. This is experienced by sadhak's doing a long session of pranayam for instance during Long kriya.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I doing my practice with commitment.
